test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 11 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Dustin is Mike's son. Will is the name of Bob's son. The son of Bob's father Alex is the brother of Mike. How is Dustin related to Will?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: 

1) Will is the name of Bob's son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/af239a6c4aff6f47223ea0c2d36598a01a85e2c8ba77995695e88a4f7845b0c1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5aa420e337eec9684c4ff13b40e1a315c68b08ea4a73494ccbca6d6169be5b72.png] 

2) The son of Bob's father Alex is the brother of Mike.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a3e0ad31eeb2fc1790e718b9c37c944dcd458571450c2b0bd1c348a4f1d402d7.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48100febbf95fa07eec4a8a653fe871c36786eee13c4def836fbc4f1d2be2a72.png] 

3) Dustin is Mike's son.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d28db2e6f1b1da43f001659b1a0cb2ac279034e69e185f2e09e383d8af829bc3.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2eec174d61fac242e89f604bd1b8d43fe53f653cd73b4850d72985c52ca3f694.png] 

So, Dustin is Will's father's sibling's (either brother or sister) son or cousin.

As out of all the options father's brother's son is given, therefore Dustin is Will's father's brothers son or cousin.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
